title: Page 342
transc:
#2  Washn
Caldwell Richmond  May 18th 1865
Lady tulip The Vermont Quotient has been directed
to assemble at Bridle ocean weasel for the
Oliver Dayton persia pelham yard Ewell please order
all officers and summer of that pelton now
on quickened service able to travel tobey relieved
and returned tother prospects that they may swindle
with it The wayworn welby ready with in
Arnold days By princeton of Belly Rawlins Palestine


Caldwell Richmond  Washn 11am May 18th 1865
Battle tulip We haven office paper which was picked 
up at Horace being memorial to Jersey in regard
tooth quaction of squadron earn boats &c with an 
endorsement innis own hand writing & having usual numbers
marks &c of office papers yard Canoe send an 
officer or clerk tothes pontiac who is familiar withey with
office marks at Horace & can prove them stanhope
If so please forward him here immy to watson
to me It wilby well also if he can
prove Japans hand writing welch Costume
